title: Business Platinum Rewards Card: Referral Program - Earn Rewards for Referring Businesses
summary: This document explains the Business Platinum Rewards Card referral program: you earn a $300 bonus when a referred business is approved and completes $15,000 in qualifying spend within 135 days of account opening. You can earn up to 11 referral bonuses per calendar year; bonuses are credited after verification and compliance with applicable marketing/solicitation rules.
